title: Rory and the Moonlit Hollow
verses:
As the shadow fell soft on the valley below,
Where Rory was watching the moon in the sky,
A breeze started gently and softly to blow,
And Nia flew past with a sleepy goodbye.

Then Benny stomped over to rest by a tree,
And Psittaco chirped from a nest in the moss.
While Ricky ran up with a giggle of glee,
To show them a stream that was easy to cross.

They walked down the path where the silver moss grew,
Where Tilly was resting beside a small mound.
The sky turned a quiet and shimmering blue,
As leaves drifted down to the pillow-soft ground.

Then Rory curled down in a bed made of moss,
As Benny lay back with a heavy, slow yawn.
A gentle breeze swept through the valley across,
To rock them to sleep till the glow of the dawn.

And Ricky tucked in at the side of his friend,
While Nia swooped down to a warm, cozy nest.
Their wonderful day had now come to an end,
And everyone knew it was time for a rest.

The stars twinkled bright in the velvet above,
While Tilly closed eyes with a sleepy, soft sigh.
The forest was wrapped in a blanket of love,
As quiet night sang them a sweet lullaby.

title: Rory and the River of Dreams
verses:
When the moon floated high over valley and crest,
Then Rory walked softly to look for a dream.
And Nia called down from her shadowy nest,
To point to a spark by the whispering stream.

Then Ricky ran fast through the moss that was deep,
While Benny stepped slow with a comforting stride.
The blossoms unfolded to rock them to sleep,
And Tilly sat down by the riverbed side.

Psittaco now nestled in leaves that were dry,
And chirped a soft song as the petals grew bright.
The blue silver shadows swept under the sky,
To welcome the peace of the quietest night.

A gentle breeze blew through the glowing green glade,
And Rory curled up on the velvety floor.
The magic of evening began to pervade,
As ripples washed light on the shimmering shore.

Then Nia now folded her wings in the tree,
While Benny rested his chin on a stone.
The stars gathered round like a bright silver sea,
Content that no friend ever slumbered alone.

Now Ricky relaxed as his breathing grew slow,
And Tilly drifted to sleep in the grass.
The moonlight continued to soften and glow,
While hours of night started gently to pass.

title: Rory and the Starlight Meadow
verses:
As twilight was fading across the green hill,
Rory stepped very softly on patches of moss.
Every valley below them grew cozy and still,
While silver-lit shadows swung gently across.

Nia swooped through the leaves in the cool summer breeze,
While Ricky leaped over a rock in the night.
She perched on a branch of the sleepy tall trees,
And watched as the heavens were painted with light.

Tilly yawned near a hollow so quiet and deep,
And Benny stretched out on the warm, sandy ground.
The forest was slowly preparing for sleep,
Without any trouble or worry or sound.

Psittaco found a place on a warm leaf to rest,
Beside Rory's tail in the calm, quiet vale.
He curled up so snug in his grassy green nest,
As stars started shining so silvery pale.

The fireflies danced with a soft golden glow,
As gentle night breezes moved through the cool air.
The sound of the river ran steady and low,
And brought a sweet comfort to everyone there.

Now Rory relaxed and he closed his big eyes,
While dreams filled the canyon so peaceful and deep.
Beneath the dark blue of the velvet night skies,
The friends drifted off in a slumbering sleep.

title: Rory and the Valley of Blossoms
verses:
The moon floated high over valley and crest,
As Rory stepped slow through the shimmering glade.
The leaves whispered low as the earth went to rest,
And shadows stretched soft in the cool piney shade.

When Nia swooped down from the top of the hill,
While Psittaco chirped from a branch up above,
They called to their friends as the forest grew still,
To share in a valley of slumber and love.

Then Ricky skipped by with a bounce in his tread,
While Tilly walked slow with a peaceful delight.
And Benny stretched out on a moss-covered bed,
To watch all the stars glowing clear in the night.

A carpet of blossoms began to unfold,
Releasing a scent that was soothing and sweet.
The petals shone bright with a shimmering gold,
To cushion the tired little dinosaur feet.

Now Psittaco nestled right under a wing,
As Rory curled down with his tail near his nose.
The crickets started softly and sweetly to sing,
To bring all the friends to a sleepy repose.

The shadows fell long as the valley grew deep,
And starlight danced light on the calm, quiet streams.
The dinos all drifted together to sleep,
To journey away into magical dreams.

title: Rory and the Glowing Valley
verses:
The moon floated up through the branches of pine,
While Nia flew down from the star-speckled height.
She whistled to Rory where long mosses twine,
To show him a hollow that sparkled with light.

Then Benny strolled over with slow, heavy paces,
And Ricky came bounding through thickets of fern.
They gathered together in shadowy spaces,
To watch how the fireflies shimmer and burn.

Psittaco chirped out from a bed in the grass,
While Tilly laid blossoms across the soft ground.
The evening turned quiet as clear as dark glass,
As peace wrapped the forest without any sound.

A breeze through the valley blew gently and deep,
While Rory yawned softly and rested his head.
The shimmering insects were lulling to sleep,
And moss made a velvety, cozy green bed.

Now Ricky curled up near the base of a tree,
And Psittaco snuggled in Nia's warm fold.
The valley was peaceful and restful and free,
Beneath a vast sky of dark purple and gold.

Then Benny snored softly, contented and still,
While Tilly closed eyes in the moonlight's soft beam.
The shadows fell over the shimmering hill,
As Rory slipped off to a beautiful dream.

title: Rory and the Starlit Shore
verses:
The stars started blinking above the grand bay,
As Rory walked slowly along the warm strand.
The tide pulled the ripples of silver away,
And left glowing pebbles to sparkle the sand.

Then Psittaco chirped from a branch up above,
While Ricky ran fast to examine a shell.
Nia swooped to the sand with a murmur of love,
As shadows of evening so softly down fell.

Then Tilly picked blossoms that gleamed in the night,
And Benny leaned low to provide a warm seat.
The fireflies danced in a soft amber light,
To quiet the rhythm of weary young feet.

Rory stretched himself out on the velvety moss,
And watched as the moon rose to light up the deep.
A breeze swung the branches of willow across,
To whisper that now was the season for sleep.

Psittaco tucked under Nia’s warm wing,
While Ricky relaxed with his head on his toes.
The crickets began in the valley to sing,
As night-breezes softly blew past every nose.

With Benny and Tilly tucked safe in the shade,
And Rory asleep as the starlight turned dim,
A blanket of dreams on the valley was laid,
While slumber swept over and rested on him.

title: Rory and the Night-Blossom Meadow
verses:
The breeze in the valley was whispering low,
As shadow and starlight began to unwind.
And Rory walked slow in the amber-lit glow,
To see what the evening had left them to find.

When Nia swooped down from the top of the tree,
Psittaco chirped from a pillow of moss.
A field of night-blossoms was easy to see,
With petals of silver that fluttered across.

Now Ricky stopped running to rest on the ground,
His tail tucked in close as he gave a deep yawn.
And Benny knelt down with a cozy soft sound,
To shelter their camp till the coming of dawn.

Then Tilly pushed leaves in a circle so wide,
To make a deep bed where the dreamers could rest.
And Psittaco snuggled right close at her side,
Like birds tucked away in the warmth of a nest.

Now Rory curled up on the moss with a sigh,
While moonbeams swept over his emerald skin.
The starlight grew dim in the evening sky,
As peaceful night whispers came drifting right in.

The stars shone like lanterns above in the deep,
The valley was bathed in a slumbering calm.
Each friend in the darkness fell softly asleep,
Wrapped up in the night like a comforting balm.

title: Rory and the Velvet Valley Stream
verses:
The stars started winking above in the sky,
As Rory walked slowly to rest by the stream.
Nia flew gently while drifting on high,
To whisper that night was beginning to dream.

Soft moss had grown thick on the edge of the shore,
Where Benny reclined with a deep, happy sigh.
And Tilly was tucking green leaves on the floor,
Beneath the grey clouds floating lazily by.

Then Ricky hopped over to settle right down,
And curled in a nest made of cedar and pine.
While Psittaco rested upon his soft crown,
Where blossoms released a calm scent so divine.

Blue fireflies danced in the shadowy glade,
They hummed a soft tune as the twilight grew deep.
The cool silver light cast a comforting shade,
To rock all the cozy young dinos to sleep.

The river sparkled and rolled through the dark,
As Rory curled up on his blanket of green.
Each shadow became just a soft, gentle mark,
Upon the most quiet and slumbering scene.

Now safe in the valley, they all closed their eyes,
As darkness wrapped over the woods like a shawl.
Soft dreams drifted down from the velvety skies,
Goodnight to the dinos, sweet slumber to all.

title: Rory and the Starlight Blossom Valley
verses:
As the moon started climbing the sleepy blue sky,
Rory walked through the forest of shimmering moss.
Where the breeze sang a song that was gentle and high,
And the streams softly rippled in silver across.

Nia swooped through the branches to flutter below,
With Psittaco riding atop of her crest.
They called out to Rory to follow the glow,
To a valley of blossoms where giants could rest.

Ricky bounced down the trail with a sleepy delight,
While Tilly stepped softly on petals of red.
Every leaf started gleaming with violet light,
Making paths for the friends to a velvet-soft bed.

Benny settled his tail on the pillow of grass,
Giving space for the friends as they gathered in line.
They all watched as the clouds started slowly to pass,
While the moon made the quiet old valley to shine.

And Psittaco now settled by Rory's warm side,
While the breeze hummed a lullaby soft through the air.
Underneath the night sky that was open and wide,
Not a worry was left in the peacefulness there.

Rory yawned with a sigh as his heavy eyes closed,
With his friends sleeping soundly together nearby.
In the stillness of evening they sweetly reposed,
While the stars sang a sleepy goodnight from the sky.

title: Rory and the Moonlit Canyon
verses:
As the stars started blinking above in the sky,
Rory walked through the canyon to look at the stream.
And Psittaco chirped from a branch that was high,
To point out a trail with a silver-bright gleam.

Then Ricky skipped past with a leap in his pace,
While Nia flew high on the cool evening breeze.
She guided their steps to a quieter place,
Right under the boughs of the ancient pine trees.

Deep moss covered stones like a soft emerald bed,
Where Benny reclined with a comfortable sigh.
And Tilly rested close as she lowered her head,
To watch all the clouds drifting peacefully by.

Now Psittaco snuggled deep into the fold,
While Ricky leaned back in the shadows to rest.
Warm shadows wrapped over the green and the gold,
As each little creature settled down in its nest.

High up in a branch, Nia folded her wings,
And Rory looked out at the tranquil night air.
The breeze hummed a song that the night-cricket sings,
Bringing peace to the friends who were slumbering there.

Soft shadows fell gently all over the ground,
As dreamland arrived with a quiet embrace.
With sweet heavy sighs and a slumber profound,
The forest grew still in this magical place.

title: Rory and the Silver Moon Cove
verses:
The stars started blinking above the lagoon,
When Nia flew down through the cool evening breeze.
She called out to Rory beneath the soft moon,
To show him a path through the tall whispering trees.

Then Ricky ran forward with hops full of grace,
While Psittaco nestled on Tilly's warm side.
Soft moss made a path to a quiet blue place,
Where Benny walked slow down the sleepy divide.

The water was glowing with bubbles of white,
And blossoms were closing their petals to rest.
Big shadows grew still in the shimmering night,
As birds drifted home to a comfortable nest.

Then Benny lay down on the bank near the stream,
While Rory curled up in a hammock of reed.
The air was as soft as a magical dream,
With all of the rest that the dinosaurs need.

Now Psittaco yawned in the curve of a wing,
As Ricky found shelter beneath a high ledge.
Soft ripples had ceased their low murmur to sing,
And sleepiness gathered around the lake edge.

Deep darkness spread over the cove far and wide,
Where Rory was drifting in dreams of his own.
With Tilly and Benny asleep by his side,
The gentlest of nights in the jungle was known.

title: Rory and the Starlight Cavern
verses:
When evening descended on moss-covered trees,
Then Rory walked slow through the shadowy lane.
Nia swooped down on a whispering breeze,
To guide all her friends from the incoming rain.

Psittaco rested on blankets of leaves,
While Ricky crept over to curl on the floor.
The night-wind blew softly beneath the high eaves,
As Benny let out a grand slumberous snore.

They marched to a canyon where starlight shone clear,
And Tilly stepped first in the glowing blue stream.
The waters ran softly and cool for the year,
To carry each friend to a sleepy young dream.

High up in a cavern of silver and stone,
Where fireflies danced in a circle of light,
Rory sat down with a warmth of his own,
And watched as the valleys turned quiet and white.

Benny lay heavy and still on the moss,
While Nia tucked under a canopy wide.
They counted the sleepy stars drifting across,
With Ricky and Tilly tucked safe at their side.

The shadows grew long as the night settled down,
And Psittaco yawned in a sleepy embrace.
Now Rory closed eyes over forest and town,
As peace settled over this magical place.

title: The Secret of the Whispering Falls
verses:
The sun dipped away behind ridges of blue,
When Nia swooped low with a chirp of delight.
She led all her friends through the shimmering dew,
To find where the waterfall glowed in the night.

Behind the cool spray was a wide, hidden shelf,
Where giant soft ferns caught the mist in the air.
Each dinosaur found a dry spot for itself,
Content with the magical calm waiting there.

Psittaco gathered dry leaves in a heap,
And made a small cushion right next to the wall.
His chirps turned to whispers, preparing for sleep,
Entranced by the soothing cascade of the fall.

Then Ricky and Benny worked side by side now,
To roll a large boulder to block out the chill.
With teamwork complete and a yawn from the brow,
They felt all the bustle of daytime go still.

Sweet Tilly leaned close to the thunder-soft sound,
Her heavy tail resting along the damp stone.
A blanket of tranquility settled around,
Ensuring that nobody rested alone.

Green Rory sank down with a satisfied sigh,
His mighty green tail curled up close to his chest.
With moon-shadows drifting across the dark sky,
The friends closed their eyes and surrendered to rest.
